name: United Heroes League
description: Greenlander vigilantes of the United Cities who call themselves city heroes and hate non-humans. Lord Mirage holds Fort Mirage, their headquarters in the Great Desert, and their squads walk the streets of Heng, Heft, Bark, Stoat, and Sho-Battai, harassing non-humans. They blame foreign races for rape, slavery, stolen jobs, and ruined farms and businesses.
